description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for testing the FormatWithPayPeriod class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance Access Strategy module. It sets up an instance of the formatter and tests its getFormattedValue method with different inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithPayPeriodIdTest
classes.description: A test class extending PHPUnit's TestCase to verify the behavior of the FormatWithPayPeriod class's getFormattedValue method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of FormatWithPayPeriod before each test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that getFormattedValue returns '1' when given 1, and 'No Pay Grade Details' when given null.
